column1: I've had a stuffy nose and sneezing for two days, what could this be?
I get throbbing one-sided headaches with nausea and light sensitivity, what might be causing this?
It burns when I urinate and I need to go very frequently, what could be wrong?
I'm always thirsty and tired and my vision is blurry sometimes, what could this mean?
I have crushing chest pain spreading to my arm and I'm sweating, what is happening?
My face drooped on one side and my speech is slurred, what could this be?
I have a red swollen warm patch on my leg near a small cut, what could this be?
I feel constantly sad, unmotivated, and can't enjoy things anymore, what could this be?
After eating shellfish my lips swelled and I'm struggling to breathe, what is this?
I have sharp pain that moved to my lower right abdomen with fever, what could this be?
